evidence.title: All of the shadcn/ui magic, none of the React | Basecoat

name: Basecoat
summary: shadcn/ui-style component library for plain HTML and Tailwind CSS, installed via CDN or npm.
description: Basecoat brings shadcn/ui's component design to any web stack without React: 41 components written as plain HTML classes (btn, card, field …) on top of Tailwind CSS, mostly CSS-only with a tiny vanilla JavaScript runtime for interactive pieces. Ships via CDN or the basecoat-css npm package, with eight theme style bundles, dark mode, shadcn/ui theme compatibility, and optional Nunjucks and Jinja macros for server-rendered markup. MIT licensed.
contains: 41 components as plain HTML plus Tailwind CSS classes
CSS-only by default; vanilla JS only for interactive components
install from CDN or the basecoat-css npm package
8 theme style bundles: vega, nova, maia, lyra, mira, luma, sera, rhea
dark mode ready and compatible with shadcn/ui themes
optional Nunjucks and Jinja macros for server-rendered apps
works with any stack: plain HTML, Flask, Rails, Laravel, Django
